official_definition: Target a family, and you can discard cards from your decktop until a Brave card with the targeted family is discarded. When you've done so, summon that card without paying the cost.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Twinkle Equip] or [Twinkle Equip: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Twinkle Equip]", "give [Twinkle Equip]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mills cards from opposing decktop to Grave.
